themes_detail.label: Park Safety & Behavior Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints in parks surged to 10 THIS WEEK (627% above the 1.4-complaint weekly average) and park rule violations exploded to 4 complaints THIS WEEK (1500% above the 0.2-complaint baseline), suggesting a sudden deterioration in park conditions or enforcement in Jackson Heights–Corona–Elmhurst parks over the past 7 days.
evidence: Noise - Park complaints: 10 THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.08)
Violation of Park Rules complaints: 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.67)
Community Board budget requests cite 'park maintenance and safety' as a recurring ask, indicating longstanding concerns
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept. about what triggered the spike in park violations and noise this week—new activity, reduced enforcement, or seasonal shift?
Canvass Jackson Heights and Corona parks to document conditions and speak with residents about safety perception

themes_detail.label: Elevator System Failures Spiking
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints in residential buildings jumped to 10 THIS WEEK (208% above the 3.2-complaint weekly average), signaling a surge in building code violations or maintenance failures across the district's aging housing stock.
evidence: Elevator complaints: 10 THIS WEEK vs. 3.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.2, 208% increase)
302 building permits filed in last 90 days; 244 are alterations, suggesting active rehab work that may include faulty elevator repairs or upkeep
Community Board repeatedly requests 'DOB budget for building code enforcement,' implying systemic building maintenance issues
reporting_angles: File FOIL request with DOB for elevator inspection violations and complaint patterns in CD 403 over the past 6 months
Interview building owners and residents in high-density areas (Jackson Heights) about elevator downtime and accessibility barriers

themes_detail.label: Green Taxi & Transportation Abuse
themes_detail.summary: Green taxi complaints surged to 4 LAST WEEK (1500% above the 0.2-complaint weekly average), indicating a concentrated pattern of unauthorized or problematic green cab activity in the district over the past 7 days.
evidence: Green Taxi Complaint: 4 LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 5.67, 1500% increase)
No prior baseline of green taxi issues in the 90-day complaint summary, making this a novel surge
reporting_angles: Contact TLC (Taxi and Limousine Commission) to identify what types of green taxi violations are being reported in this district and whether a specific operator or route is involved
Interview residents in high-transit areas about green cab behavior (illegal pickup zones, aggressive driving, fare disputes)

themes_detail.label: Litter & Sanitation Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests climbed to 7 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO (700% above the 0.9-complaint weekly average), indicating residents perceive inadequate street sanitation infrastructure in Jackson Heights–Corona–Elmhurst.
evidence: Litter Basket Request: 7 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 7.85, 700% increase)
Long-running pattern: Dirty Condition complaints (297 in 90 days) rank 10th overall, and Community Board budget requests emphasize 'park maintenance' and environmental protection
reporting_angles: Map litter basket complaints to identify which blocks are most underserved; verify if DSNY has scheduled maintenance or removal in those areas
Interview sanitation workers and residents about whether trash basket capacity has been reduced or collection frequency has declined

themes_detail.label: Door & Window Code Violations Rising
themes_detail.summary: Door and window complaints increased to 17 TWO WEEKS AGO (81% above the 9.4-complaint weekly average), suggesting a wave of housing maintenance or security issues in residential buildings across the district.
evidence: Door/Window complaints: 17 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 9.4 weekly average (z-score: 3.95, 81% increase)
244 of 302 recent building permits are alterations, consistent with renovation-related door/window issues or structural work
reporting_angles: Interview DOB about citations related to door/window violations and whether there is a pattern (broken seals, missing locks, fire safety issues)
Speak with tenants in older buildings about security concerns related to deteriorating doors and windows
